text: conceptSetList numeric vector ATLAS concept set IDs download. conceptSetType character string used group downloaded concept set JSON files inst/concept_sets/. baseUrl character string base URL ATLAS WebAPI. deletePrevious logical value indicating whether delete existing files target <conceptSetType> folder downloading new concept sets. patternToRemove vector regular expressions containing pattern(s) removed ATLAS concept set names creating output JSON files. authHeader Authorization header WebAPI. title: Update values in a summarised result — updateColumnValues
code: x <- dplyr::tibble(  "result_id" = 1L,  "cdm_name" = "cprd",  "group_name" = "cohort_name",  "group_level" = c(    "acetaminophen",    "acetaminophen",    "diclofenac",    "ibuprofen"    ),  "strata_name" = "sex &&& age_group",  "strata_level" = c(    "male &&& <40",    "male &&& >=40",    "male &&& >=40",    "male &&& >=40"    ),  "variable_name" = "number_subjects",  "variable_level" = NA_character_,  "estimate_name" = "count",  "estimate_type" = "integer",  "estimate_value" = c("5", "15", "8", "12"),  "additional_name" = "overall",  "additional_level" = "overall" ) |>  omopgenerics::newSummarisedResult() #> `result_type`, `package_name`, and `package_version` added to settings. names_map <- c(  "acetaminophen" = "Acetaminophen cohort",  "diclofenac" ="Diclofenac cohort (outdated)",  "ibuprofen" = "Ibuprofen cohort" ) x <- updateColumnValues(  summarised_result = x,  names_map = names_map,  variable = "group_level" )
